about.label: About the Society
about.title: The Home of CSE Student Life at IIT Delhi
body: ACES-ACM is the departmental student society of Computer Science & Engineering at IIT Delhi, and the department's ACM Student Chapter. We bring together students across every year and programme.
Through the year we run technical talks, workshops, research initiatives, hackathons, and socials — including our flagship CSE Research Symposium. This is filler copy; edit data/home.json to update.
